findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trends___get_context, trends___get_growth, trends___get_reviews, trends___get_time_series, trends___get_top_trends · Private data: trends___get_top_trends · Public sink: trends___get_reviews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trends___get_context, trends___get_growth, trends___get_reviews, trends___get_time_series, trends___get_top_trends · Private data: trends___get_top_trends · Public sink: trends___get_reviews

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "trends___get_context" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
